decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting fits the firm's robust specialist niche with long procurement cycles, and the large firm has the slack to carry it while defence demand is rising.
The spring-balanced desk lamp has its own page and supports the ergonomic workplace lighting portfolio, so there is no evident shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
A newly arrived second-generation general interior luminaire is a core-business refresh that the firm is actively promoting.
The firm presents this microprismatic pendant as a flagship of its direction, so it is strategically committed and highly unlikely to be dropped soon.
HMI searchlights face pressure from the LED transition, but the marine specialist line is low-cost to maintain and serves existing customers, so it is kept for now.
The marine searchlight line complements the naval and specialist offering and is only mentioned, with no sign of underperformance against aspirations.
